requirement: A device sign-in (ChatGPT Codex on the web) keeps polling through a tracy-web restart instead of failing with "Unexpected token '<'"; a one-shot call that gets the proxy's page says the server did not answer

oracle.ref: PR #1226 (fix); fix evidence: dev cowork.tracy.site 12/10/2026 09:12Z: the web container restarted for a deploy while a tester confirmed a ChatGPT Codex device code; the poll got the proxy's HTML page and the panel showed "Could not connect ChatGPT Codex — Unexpected token '<', \"<!DOCTYPE \"... is not valid JSON". Screens: tasks/evidence/device-poll-transient/codex-device-transient-{light,dark}.png
oracle.invariant: seatPlanApi rejects with TransientError (transient: true) on an HTML 502 page, a 503/504, an HTML body with 200 and a failed fetch; never with a JSON parse error. A 400 with a JSON message keeps that message and is not transient; a 200 JSON body is the data. waitForDevice asks again after a TransientError: pending, transient, transient, status resolves with waits 5000, 5000, 5000, 10000; consecutive failures wait 5 s, 10 s, 20 s, 30 s, 30 s (capped), and the normal interval comes back after an answer. A non-transient error still ends the attempt with its message; Cancel (abort) still stops; failures past DEVICE_LIMIT_MS end as DeviceTimeout. startConnect re-reports the device state with retrying: true while polls fail and without it at the next answer; a transient connect/start fails with reason 'transient' and an empty message. Settings > AI accounts keeps the code visible and shows [data-hint='transient'] 'The server is restarting or unreachable. Trying again…' under 'Waiting for {vendor} to confirm…' while polls fail, and removes it at the next good answer; a transient start shows 'The server did not answer. Try again.' with Try again.
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)

assertionIds: seatPlanApi: an HTML error page from the proxy (502) is a TransientError, never a JSON parse error
seatPlanApi: a 503/504 with a JSON body, an HTML body with 200, and a network failure are all transient
seatPlanApi: a 400 with a JSON message keeps that message and is not transient
seatPlanApi: a 200 JSON answer is the data, whatever the content type spells
a start the server never answered (proxy page, network) fails as transient, not as the parse error
a device sign-in keeps its code while the server restarts: retrying while polls fail, cleared at the next answer
a poll the server did not answer is asked again: pending, transient, transient, then the status
the wait doubles per failure in a row from 5 s, never past 30 s, and falls back once an answer comes
a network failure of the call itself (fetch rejected) is asked again too
a refusal that is not transient still ends the attempt with its message
Cancel during the failures still stops: no more polls, the wait rejects with the reason
failures that last past the ten minutes end the attempt as a timeout
a poll the restarting server did not answer keeps the code and says so, then the line goes at the next answer
a start the restarting server did not answer says so in plain words with Try again, never the parse error
